notes.title: Update 1.1.23
notes.notes: Event  limit on Map editor has changed 256 to 512. You can build more huge dungeon.

notes.title: Update 1.1.22
notes.notes:
Thank you very much to everyone who played BQM.
We hope, that with BlockQuest Maker, players will have fun creating and sharing dungeons around the world.
Since debut two days ago, our team has received many feedbacks and suggestions on how to improve the game. With this said, we have decided that to enable players the best gaming experience we will enable some dungeon parts in Builders Mode from the start. With this update players will have freedom needed and Chance to unleash creativity.
You will need GOLD to buy further parts and traps that will be added in the future though.
We at WonderlandKazakiri will make our utmost effort to bring you best gaming experience, so please look forward to UPDATES that are yet to come!
